Order 07/10/2025
1.

The instant bail applications filed by the applicants challenging the bail rejection order dated
10.09.2025 passed by Additional Sessions Judge, Bhinmal, District Jalore in connection with the
Fir No. 121/2023 registered at Police Station Bagora, (Uploaded on 07/10/2025 at 07:21:41 Pm)
[2025:Rj-Jd:44023] (2 of 3) [Crlmb-11322/2025] District Jalore for the offences under Sections
419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of Ipc.
2.

Learned counsel for the applicants submits that they are the land holders and taken certain loans
under the Kisan Credit Card from the nationalized bank.

However, the counsel fairly admitted that
the applicants are illiterate persons, they were misguided and did not furnish the correct details to
the bank while taking the financial assistance.

The counsel further submits that though the Fir was
lodged in the year 2023, however, the applicants were arrested by the police on 05.09.2025 i.e. after
more than two years. By the above fact, the counsel tried to present that the applicants are resident
of the village and have no intention to run away or to affect investigation.

The learned counsel
further submits that concerned Patwari namely Puran Singh who issued the relevant documents in
their favor which applicants further submitted to the bank also filed bail application before the
learned trial court bearing No. 409/2025 in which he has been enlarged on bail vide order dated
18.09.2025.

He further submits that the present case is exclusively triable by the Judicial Magistrate
and the present applicants are also entitled for the similar relief.

3. Learned Public Prosecutor strongly opposed the bail applications and submitted that the
impugned Fir registered against as many as 28 farmers who collectively submitted wrong
information regarding their lands on account of which the nationalized bank granted the financial
assistance to them.

Intentionally the false information was given and therefore, their intention is
clear from the record.

(Uploaded on 07/10/2025 at 07:21:41 Pm) [2025:Rj-Jd:44023] (3 of 3) [Crlmb-11322/2025]
4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Perused the documents on record.

This Court noted that
the concerned Patwari who issued the revenue record in favor of the present applicants has already
been enlarged on bail by learned trial court vide order dated 18.09.2025, although on the ground
that he has a medical problem.

Be that as it may, the applicants are the resident of the village and
from last two years from the date of registration of the Fir, they have not run away from the village
and are ready to cooperate in the investigation.

5. Accordingly, the bail applications filed under Section 483 Bnss, are allowed and it is directed that
applicants-Ompuri S/o Dungarpuri, Chimnaram S/o Gangaram, Punmaram S/o Chimnaram,
Kheraj Ram S/o Paarna Ram, Puraram S/o Poonma, Malaram S/o Bhiya Ram and Valaram S/o
Bhiya Ram shall be released on bail in connection with Fir No.121/2023 of Police Station Bagora,
District Jalore, provided they execute a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sound

and solvent sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial Court for their appearance before that Court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.
The applicants are further directed not to take undue advantage of liberty or Malaram vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:44023) on 7 October, 2025

2 misuse liberty and cooperate in the investigation fairly.
It is made clear that the observation as made by this Court in the bail applications will not affect the trial of the case.

(RAVI CHIRANIA),J 136-137--Jatin/-
